map.可以。core.autocrlf=true 在检出时转 CRLF、提交时转 LF: Yes. core.autocrlf=true converts to CRLF on checkout and to LF on commit (suitable for Windows); Linux/macOS should use input (convert to LF on commit, leave checkout unchanged). A more reliable approach is to commit a .gitattributes file (for example * text=auto) that sets the convention for everyone, rather than depending on each person's local config.
